changes.title: Needle drop sound
items: After the party spell, the witch drops the needle on her record and does a little scratching routine behind her decks
Back at her decks after a knockout, she scratches a little while she waits

changes.title: Sad trumpet
items: Knocked down, a sad trumpet goes "wah-wah-wah-waaah" as her hat floats to the floor
A record scratch cuts the trumpet off as she's whisked back to her decks

changes.title: Hat iris
items: Knocked down, the screen closes in on your fallen hat, which spins into a record, rewinds with a scratch and opens on you back at your decks
